meaning: operational health; not a profitability or staking signal
release_blockers: multi_book_consensus: >=75% current games covered by 2+ verified books
historical_entry_integrity: promotion sample uses explicit opening-entry observations, not archive-final fallbacks
historical_market_edge: ROBUST NFL evidence with positive ROI confidence lower bound and CLV across markets/seasons
forward_entry_integrity: 100% graded forward bets have execution-ready, timestamp-valid entry quotes
forward_clv_coverage: >=90% of graded forward bets have a valid later pre-kickoff closing snapshot
live_shadow_evidence: >=300 graded portfolio-verified live/shadow bets, non-negative ROI, positive CLV, complete entry provenance, and >=90% CLV coverage
